paper_metadata.title: New insights into the partitioning behavior of Mo in nickel-based superalloys and its effect on microstructure using CALPHAD-assisted phase field modeling

evidence.section: Abstract
evidence.quote: This study examines the effects of Cr concentration on elemental distribution behaviors and γ′ evolution in Ni–10Al–4Mo–xCr superalloys using CALPHAD-informed phase field modeling.
Ni – 10Al – 4Mo – x Cr alloys aged at 1073 K

evidence.section: Conclusion
evidence.quote: The final γ ′ shape of the Ni – 10Al – 4Mo – x Cr ( x = 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, and 7 at.%) superalloys represents cubic due to the larger γ / γ ′ lattice mismatch.
The measured γ ′ coarsening rates are 0.43, 0.54, 0.58, 0.66, 0.74, and 0.88 for 2Cr, 3Cr, 4Cr, 5Cr, 6Cr, and 7Cr alloys, respectively.
